lines.text: Well, howdy, partner! Pull up a crate and rest them boots.
Hey there, buddy! You look like you drove through a tornado... backwards.
Now there's a face I ain't seen! Pleased to meet ya, partner.
Welcome, welcome! Any friend of the road is a friend of mine.
Well, look what the dust dragged in! Howdy!
Hey, partner! Careful, the ground's hot enough to fry a steak.
Howdy! Folks call me big. It ain't about my belt, I swear.
Well, shoot, a traveler! Come on over, I don't bite. Much.
Afternoon, buddy! Or morning. Hell, I lost my watch in eighty-seven.
Hey there! You drive, or you walk? Either way, you made it. Respect.
Eighteen wheels, twelve gears, and not one working radio... I miss that rig.
Back in Texas, we had a word for weather like this: Tuesday.
I once hauled a whole house across three states. Didn't even scratch the porch.
Hmm, hmm, hmm... man, I'd kill for a truck-stop coffee right now.
Everything's bigger in Texas. Including the crater, turns out.
My old rig could pull a mountain. This here world? It pulled the plug.
Some fella asked me if I miss the highway. Buddy, I AM the highway.
I've seen sunsets from Amarillo to the end of the world. This one's about average.
Diesel, dust, and a little bit of hope. That's my breakfast.
You know what the wasteland needs? A good barbecue joint. With a drive-thru.
My mama always said, 'Son, don't go chasing the horizon.' Well, Mama, I caught it.
I'm not lost. I'm just taking the scenic route... for six years.
Hauled chickens, hauled lumber, hauled a circus once. Never hauled regret. Till now.
Ten-four, good buddy... Nobody answers anymore. Still, habit.
Rain on the roof... reminds me of sleeping in the cab, back in the good days.
Snow! Lord, I ain't seen snow since that blizzard in Amarillo. Froze my mustache solid.
Night drivin' was always my favorite. Just you, the stars, and whatever's hunting you.
It's so hot, my sweat's sweatin'. Whew!
Colder than a trucker's welcome at a weigh station, I tell ya.
Dust storm rollin' in! Batten down the hatches, partner, and pull your bandana up.
Whoa, easy there, partner! This ain't a demolition derby.
Hey, buddy, you got a license for them elbows?
Oof! Careful now. I'm a big target, but I ain't a door.
Easy, easy! You bump like a jackknifed trailer.
Well, hello to you too! Personal space, buddy.
Watch it, now! I got a bad back from forty years in a cab.
Ha! You ran into me like I was a parked truck. I kinda am.
Whoa! Check your mirrors, partner!
Hey! Slow down! That ain't how you pass a man!
Easy on the gas, buddy! I nearly became a hood ornament!
Now that's some sloppy lane discipline right there!
Hey! In Texas, we'd pull you over for that! If we had cops!
Brake, buddy! Brake! It's the pedal in the middle!
Ow! Dang it, I got hit by a car. Me! A trucker!
Agh... that's embarrassing. Forty years on the road, and I get run over walking.
Oof! Buddy, you owe me a new hip. And a beer.
Son of a... you're lucky I'm built like a Peterbilt!
You got it, partner.
Ten-four, buddy. Consider it hauled.
Deal! Shake on it, like men of the road.
Sure thing. I never back down from a job.
Alright, alright. I'm in!
Nope. Not for all the diesel in Houston.
Sorry, buddy. That's a hard no, with a jake brake on it.
Ain't happening, partner. Not today, not tomorrow.
Negative, good buddy. Over and out.
I'd rather drive a clown car to a funeral.
Ha! Haha! Oh, partner, that's a good one!
Hoo-wee! You're funnier than a flat tire on a unicycle!
Ha! I'm gonna tell that one at every campfire from here to the coast.
Haha! Oh, lordy, my belly hurts!
Now hold on, buddy. That's no way to talk to a Texan.
Well, that's just rude. My mama would've washed your mouth out with diesel.
Easy, partner. I've punched bigger fellas for less.
Huh. And here I thought we were gonna be friends.
You talk big for someone who walks everywhere.
Whoa, now. Let's not get ugly, partner.
You don't wanna do that, buddy. I've wrestled bulls.
Easy... easy. Put it down, and we'll forget this happened.
Partner, I've been threatened by tornadoes. You ain't scary.
Much obliged, partner!
Well, ain't you a gentleman of the road! Thank ya!
Thank ya kindly, buddy. I'll remember that.
You're alright, you know that? Mighty good of you.
Keep the shiny side up and the rubber side down, partner!
Ten-four, buddy. Catch you on the flip side.
Drive safe now! Or at least drive fast.
Happy trails, partner. Don't pick up hitchhikers. Unless they're pretty.
See ya down the road, buddy!
Y'all come back now. I'll keep the coffee... well, I'll keep the pot.
Alright, alright! You drive a harder bargain than a weigh-station clerk!
Fine, partner. Friends' price. Don't tell nobody.
Shoot, you got me. I'm a softie at heart.
Nice try, buddy. Price is as firm as my handshake.
Ha! You haggle like a rookie at his first truck stop.
Nope. That's the price, partner. Take it or leave it.
Pleasure doing business, partner! Use it well.
There ya go, buddy. Hauled it all the way here just for you.
Sold! Now that's a fine piece of merchandise, if I do say so.
Take good care of it, partner. It's got stories.
I'll take that off your hands, buddy. Looks like it's seen some miles.
Now that's a nice haul! Here's your scrap.
Deal! I'll find a good home for it.
Ooh, I can use this. Good trade, partner.
Sorry, buddy. No scrap, no deal. Even truckers got bills.
Your pockets are emptier than a truck stop at three a.m.
Come back when you've got the scrap, partner. I'll hold it for ya. Maybe.
Alright, that's it! You just messed with Texas!
Hey! You wanna fight? Let's dance, partner!
Oh, you did NOT just do that!
Come on! I've wrestled steers tougher than you!
That all you got, buddy?
Yeehaw! Now we're havin' fun!
You hit like a hatchback!
Agh! Dang it!
Ow! Now you made it personal!
Oof! That's gonna bruise, partner.
Aaah! My good side!
Hngh! Lucky shot!
Whoa, whoa, I'm out! I'm haulin' outta here!
Nope! Time to hit the road!
Retreat! I got a rig to get back to!
Alright! Alright, partner! Uncle! I give up!
Okay, you win! Don't mess up the face, it's my best feature!
I quit! I know when I'm beat. Mostly.
Well, howdy, fresh meat! Welcome to my toll road.
Nice ride, partner. Real nice. I'll take good care of it.
Pull over, buddy. This here's a weigh station, and you're overweight.
Hey there! Everything you own is mine now. Texas rules.
Back in the day, I hauled freight. Now I haul other folks' freight. Same thing, really.
Boss says we hit the next convoy at dawn. I say, why not brunch?
Man, I miss honest work. No, I don't.
Polished my spikes today. They're gleamin' like a chrome bumper.
Whoever took my last beef jerky is gettin' a tire iron to the knee.
Convoy! Saddle up, boys!
There they are! Let's ride!
Fresh wheels on the horizon! Yeehaw!
Get 'em, boys! Don't scratch the paint!
Your truck's mine, partner!
Yeehaw! Run, little doggie, run!
I'm gonna mount your hubcaps on my grille!
Pull over! I got a ticket for ya: one way, to the ditch!
Everything's bigger in Texas! Especially the beating you're about to get!
Come on, buddy! Don't make me chase ya!
Ha! You drive like a tourist!
Hand over the fuel, and nobody gets bent!
Watch it, fresh meat!
Bump me again, and you'll be road jam, partner.
What do you want? Speak up, or git!
Another stranger. Wonderful. Just what I needed today.
Don't look at me like that. I ain't no zoo animal.
Hmph. You got a face like a busted boot.
Who told you you could walk up on a man like that?
If you're here to preach, I got a shotgun that disagrees.
State your business, and make it short. I'm busy drinkin'.
Oh, look. Somebody new to disappoint me.
Get off my porch. I don't care that I ain't got a porch.
Well? Don't just stand there breathin' my air!
Dadburn flies. Dadburn heat. Dadburn everything.
Back in my day, the world ended quietly. Now look at it.
Nobody listens to an old man. Well, good. I ain't talkin' to you anyhow.
Where'd I put my jug? Somebody took my jug!
Government said it'd all be fine. Government's dead. Ha!
My knees hurt, my teeth hurt, and my patience died in the war.
Every day, the same sun, the same dirt, the same idiots.
I've outlived my wife, my dog, and civilization. Ain't that grand.
Hmm... hmph. Mutter, mutter, mutter.
They say whiskey rots your gut. Good. Gives it somethin' to do.
Young folks today can't even skin a rat proper. Shameful.
I was mean before the bombs. The bombs just gave me a reason.
If one more fella asks me for directions, I'm givin' 'em the wrong ones.
Consarned wind blew my hat off again. Third time this week!
Rain. Great. Now the mud's gonna get in my boots AND my jug.
Snow... my bones can feel every flake. Every dadburn flake.
Night's the only time folks leave me alone. Mostly.
Hot as the devil's armpit out here. And about as fragrant.
Cold enough to freeze the shine in the jar. That's a crime, that is.
Dust storm! Figures. Even the sky's got a mean streak.
Hey! Watch where you're stompin', you clumsy fool!
You touch me again, and I'll tan your hide.
Get your elbows outta my ribs!
Are you blind, or just plain dumb?
Back off! I bite. I ain't got many teeth, but I bite.
Knock it off! I'm an old man, not a hitching post!
Walk around me, you lummox!
Slow down, you danged fool!
Hey! Learn to drive, idiot!
You near run me down! I'll remember that face!
Road hog! Road hog!
Go on! Kill an old man! See if I care! ...I care!
Keep drivin' like that, and you'll be buried next to my wife!
Agh! You ran me over! You ran over an old man!
Ow! My hip! My good hip! Now I got none!
You sorry son of a... I'll sue ya! Soon as there's lawyers!
Ugh... I'll get you for this. When I can stand.
Fine. But I ain't happy about it.
Yeah, yeah. Alright. Stop pesterin' me.
Hmph. If it gets you outta my sight, fine.
Deal. Now git.
Alright, but you're buyin' the next jug.
No. N, O. No.
Not a chance. Now scram.
Heck no. I'd sooner kiss a rattler.
Nope. Ask me again, and the answer's gonna have buckshot in it.
Over my dead body. Which, at my age, won't be long. Still no.
Heh. Heh heh. Alright, that one got me.
Ha! Well, I'll be. You ain't completely useless.
Heh! Don't tell nobody I laughed.
Hah! That's almost as funny as your face.
Why, you ungrateful whelp!
Say that again, and I'll knock your teeth into next week.
I've been insulted by better men. And buried most of 'em.
You got a mouth on you. Shame there ain't a brain behind it.
Hmph. Your mama must be real proud.
You threatenin' me? I've been shot three times. Ain't dead yet.
Go on, then. Do it. I dare ya.
You pull that on me again, and they'll never find the body.
Put that away, before I shove it somewhere unpleasant.
Hmph. Thanks, I guess.
Well... I suppose that was decent of ya.
Don't expect a hug.
Thanks. Now go away, before I get sentimental.
Good riddance.
Git. And don't come back without whiskey.
Yeah, yeah, goodbye. Don't let the wasteland hit you on the way out.
Finally. Some peace and quiet.
Scram! Go bother somebody younger!
Leave already. I'm gettin' old just lookin' at ya.
Fine! Robbery, that's what it is! Plain robbery!
Alright, alright! Take it, and quit your yappin'.
Consarned hagglers. Fine. Your price.
Ha! You call that hagglin'? Price stays, and you can cry about it.
Nope. My price. Take it or choke on it.
Try that again, and the price doubles.
There. Now take it, and git.
Sold. No refunds, no crybabies.
Don't come whinin' to me when it breaks.
Here. It's worth every scrap, and then some.
Hmph. Junk. But I'll take it.
Fine, I'll buy it. Don't expect a fair price.
Where'd you steal this? Never mind. Here.
Alright. Scrap's scrap.
No scrap? Then quit wastin' my time!
Broke as a busted jug. Git outta here.
I don't do charity. I barely do manners.
Alright, you asked for it!
Why, you... I'll whup you proper!
That's it! Somebody hand me my shotgun!
Come on, whelp! Show me what you got!
Ha! I've fought mules meaner than you!
That all? My wife hit harder, God rest her.
Take that, you varmint!
Agh! Dadburn it!
Ow! My back!
Ungh! You'll pay for that!
Argh! Lucky shot, whelp!
Hngh! That's comin' outta your hide!
I'm too old for this! I'm out!
Lord help me, I'm runnin'!
Nope! Not dyin' sober!
Alright! Alright, I quit! Don't shoot an old man!
Fine! You win! Take my jug, just let me live!
Mercy! I'm too ornery to die today!
Well, well. Fresh meat. Hand it over, or I take it off your corpse.
Nice ride. Shame about the driver. Out!
This here's my road, whelp. Pay up.
Toll's everything you got. And your boots. I like them boots.
Boss keeps sayin' 'patience'. I'll show him patience. With a pipe.
Ain't had a decent fight in days. Gettin' soft.
Hmph. Them new recruits couldn't rob a lemonade stand.
Sharpened my machete. Sharpened my temper, too.
I'll be glad when we hit that convoy. I'm bored stupid.
There they are! Get 'em!
Fresh meat! Wake up, you lazy dogs!
Convoy on the road! Move it, move it!
I see ya! Can't hide from me, varmint!
Run, whelp! I like 'em runnin'!
I'll wear your skull as a hubcap!
Your car's gonna make a fine chicken coop!
Come here! I ain't gonna hurt ya... much!
Ha! Scream louder!
Gonna tan your hide and sell it by the pound!
Nowhere to run, varmint!
Stop squirmin'! It's just robbery!
Watch it, or lose it.
Touch me again, and I'll bury ya.
Well, well! Ladies, gentlemen, and mutants, we have a new contestant!
Hey there! Welcome to the end of the world. Please keep your arms inside the ride.
Howdy, stranger! Don't mind the smell, that's just the ambience.
Ooh, a new face! Mine's been getting old. Literally.
Well, if it ain't the cavalry! Where's the rest of the cavalry?
Hi there! I'd shake your hand, but I don't know where it's been. I know where mine's been. Worse.
Welcome, friend! You're just in time for the apocalypse. Again.
Hey, you're alive! Congratulations, that's the hardest part.
Howdy! Jokes are my game, and the rent is... nonexistent!
Oh good, company! I was starting to laugh at my own jokes. Well, I still will.
Why did the mutant cross the road? It had four legs. It could do whatever it wanted.
They say laughter's the best medicine. Good thing, 'cause we ran out of the real stuff.
I told my wife I'd take her somewhere hot. Nuclear winter was not what she meant.
This is your host, coming to you live from a ditch. Weather today: brown.
I used to be a stand-up comic. Now I'm a sit-down survivor. Knees gave out.
What do you call a raider with no car? A pedestrian. What do you call him after that? Dinner.
I'm not saying the water's bad, but my reflection filed a complaint.
Scrap happens. That's my motto. Also my business model.
Knock knock! ...Nobody's there. Nobody's ever there. It's the apocalypse.
I tried to organize a hide-and-seek tournament. Good players are hard to find.
My doctor said I need more fiber. I ate a rope. Now I'm tied up.
What's the best thing about the end of the world? No more Mondays. Every day's a Monday.
I've got a joke about radiation. You'll get it in about twenty years.
Rust in peace, old buddy. Rust in peace.
Rain again! Great, now everything smells like wet dog. Including the dog.
Snow! Finally, the world's wearing white. Probably for its own funeral.
Nighttime! When the stars come out. And the wolves. And the guys with knives. Romantic!
It's so hot, I saw a lizard use a potholder.
It's so cold, the raiders are stealing sweaters instead of fuel.
Dust storm! Free exfoliation, folks. Spa day's on the house!
Whoa! Buy me dinner first!
Hey, if you wanted a hug, you coulda just asked.
Excuse me! This dance is taken.
Ow! Watch it, I'm fragile. Like my ego.
Hey! Two feet of wasteland, and you pick mine. Thanks!
Careful! I bruise like a banana. A radioactive banana.
Personal space, pal! It's the only real estate I own.
Whoa! Nice driving, Evel Knievel!
Hey! The road's that way! ...Oh wait, it IS the road.
Speed limit's fifty-five, pal! ...Just kidding, there's no speed limit! Still!
Ha! Missed me! Try again next... no, please don't!
Beep beep, huh? Wile E. Coyote over here!
Careful! I'm a pedestrian! An endangered species!
Ow! Okay, okay, I'll admit it... you got me. Literally!
Aaagh! I guess I'll be... de-tired. Get it? Ow.
Hit and run? That's my line! Ow!
Ugh... I saw my whole life flash by. It was mostly punchlines.
You betcha! I'm on the case!
Why not? Life's short. Mine especially.
Deal! Shake on it. Wash your hand first.
Sure thing! I'll put it right on my to-do list. It's a short list.
Absolutely! What could possibly go wrong? Don't answer that.
Hmm... let me think... no!
That's a hard pass, friend. Hard like my bread.
No can do! Not even for a laugh.
Ha! Good one! Oh, you're serious? Still no.
Tempting... but nope!
Ha! Hahaha! Oh, you're good! Want a job?
Hah! Stealing that one. It's mine now.
Ha! Okay, you're funnier than me. Don't tell anyone.
Hahaha! Oh, my ribs! Both of 'em!
Ouch! I'd come back at you, but I don't punch down.
Wow. Rude. Wasteland rude, but rude.
That's cute. Did your mama write that for you?
Hey, I'm the comedian here. Get your own act.
Ha, ha... No, really, that hurt. Right in the feelings.
Whoa, whoa! Put that down! I bruise easy, and I bleed jokes!
Easy, pal! I'm just the entertainment!
You don't wanna do that! Who'd tell the jokes?
Okay, okay! Tough crowd!
Aw, thanks! You're a peach! A slightly irradiated peach!
Thank you, thank you! I'll be here all week! And every week after.
Much obliged! I'll name a joke after you.
You're alright! A real gem. A dusty gem.
Goodnight, and good luck! That's what the fella on TV used to say.
Stay alive out there! It's the new black.
See ya! Don't do anything I wouldn't do. Which is nothing, I've done it all.
Bye now! Tip your waitress! There's no waitress. Tip me.
Adios, amigo! Try not to get eaten!
Catch you later! Or catch you never! Either way, it was fun!
Alright, alright! You win! I'll take the loss, I'm used to it!
Fine! You've got me laughing too hard to argue.
Deal! My accountant's gonna kill me. I don't have an accountant.
Ha! Nice try, pal. That's comedy, not commerce.
Nope! The price is the punchline, and the punchline is final.
Oh, you're haggling? Cute. No.
Sold! To the lucky customer with the questionable judgment!
Enjoy! Returns accepted never!
There you go! It comes with a free joke: this deal!
Pleasure doing business! Mostly my pleasure!
I'll take it! One man's trash is another man's... also trash, but I'll sell it.
Ooh, shiny! Deal!
Sure, I'll buy it. What is it? Never mind, don't care!
Here's your scrap! Don't spend it all in one wasteland.
No scrap? That's the saddest joke I've heard all day.
Your wallet's as empty as my comedy club.
Broke, huh? Welcome to the club! Membership's free!
Oh, it's on! This is gonna be a knee-slapper!
Alright, funny guy! Let's see who's laughing now!
Fight! Fight! Oh wait, it's me!
Is that all you got? My grandma hits harder, and she's a skeleton!
Ha! Missed me! Missed me! Now you gotta... never mind!
Come on! Hit me with your best shot! No, wait, not your best!
Ooh, scary! I'm shaking! It's the cold, actually!
Ow! That's not funny!
Agh! Okay, okay, that one landed!
Ouch! Tough crowd!
Ow! Right in the punchline!
Hngh! I'll laugh about this later!
Show's over, folks! Exit stage left!
Nope! The comedian has left the building!
Run away! Run away! It's the only bit that always works!
Alright! You win! I surrender! I'm a lover, not a fighter!
Uncle! Aunt! Second cousin! I give up!
White flag! Imagine it's white! It's the only rag I got!
Welcome to the toll road! The toll is: everything! Surprise!
Good news! You've been selected for our robbery program!
Hey there! Nice car. Mind if I... keep it? Forever?
Ladies and gentlemen, it's a stick-up! No applause, please!
Why do we wear spiky shoulders? Branding! It's all about the branding!
I joined the gang for the dental plan. There's no dental plan.
The boss says I'm too funny to be a raider. I say I'm too raider to be funny.
What do you call a raider who can't steal? Unemployed! Ha!
I tried robbing a mime once. He didn't say a thing.
Showtime, boys! We got an audience!
Fresh meat, fresh laughs! Let's roll!
There they go! Chase scene, take one!
Oh, a convoy! It's like Christmas, but with more stabbing!
Honk if you're about to lose everything!
Knock knock! Who's there? Your worst nightmare!
Your car's gonna look great in my collection! Right next to my other stolen cars!
Run, run! Cardio's good for you!
Nice tires! Mine now! Tire-rific!
Why so serious? It's just a little grand theft auto!
I'd tell you a joke, but you're the punchline!
Pull over! We need to have a little talk! With pipes!
Hey! Watch it, or I'll tell you my worst joke!
Bump me again, and you'll be the joke!
Oh! Oh, Lord, you startled me. Bless you, stranger.
Peace be with you, child. And with your... is that a weapon? Peace be with that, too.
Welcome, welcome, pilgrim. Have you come far? Everybody's come far.
The Lord sends strangers for a reason. I hope yours is a good one.
Hello, hello! Don't mind me, I'm just a humble servant. With a twitch.
Good day, traveler! Or is it? I can never tell anymore.
Ah, a new soul! Tell me, friend, have you been saved? From anything?
Bless my soul, a visitor! You're not an angel of death, are you? Just checking.
Greetings, child. The end came, and yet here we stand. Praise be. I think.
Oh, hello! Please don't shoot. I've got a sermon half written.
And on the seventh day, He rested. Then the bombs fell on the eighth.
Lord, give me strength. And a roof. And maybe a sandwich.
The meek shall inherit the earth. Well, here it is, meek folks. Enjoy.
Every noise out there... every single noise... is it teeth? It sounds like teeth.
I prayed for rain. I got acid rain. The Lord has a sense of humor.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be... robbed, mostly.
I keep a candle lit for the old world. Also, I'm scared of the dark.
Revelations said four horsemen. Didn't mention the dune buggies.
My flock is small now. Two goats and a fella named Earl. Earl doesn't listen.
Oh, I heard something! ...It was me. My stomach. Lord, forgive my stomach.
Thou shalt not steal. Unless it's from raiders. I'm fairly sure that's allowed.
Faith, hope, and canned beans. The holy trinity of the wasteland.
I baptized a man in the river last week. He came up glowing. Blessing or radiation? Hard to say.
Have mercy, have mercy... on all of us, and on my knees.
Rain from heaven! Don't drink it, though. Heaven's been a bit off lately.
Snow... white as a lamb. Cold as a tax collector's heart. God rest 'em.
Night falls... Lord, watch over us. And please keep the wolves on the far side of the hill.
This heat is a sermon on hellfire, and I'm listening, Lord, I'm listening!
So cold... even my prayers are coming out in little clouds.
A storm of dust! Like the plagues of Egypt! Everyone inside, quickly, quickly!
Oh! Oh, goodness! Forgive me! Or forgive you! Somebody's forgiven!
Ah! You nearly gave me a heart attack, child!
Easy, easy! These old bones are held together with prayer.
Lord have mercy, watch where you walk!
Oof! Turn the other cheek, they say. Please don't bump that one too.
Oh, my! Was that an accident? Please say it was an accident.
Heavens! I'm an old man, not a bowling pin!
Lord Jesus! That was close!
Slow down, child! You're driving like the devil himself!
Oh! Oh, my heart! My poor heart!
Mercy! The Lord takes the wheel, but He'd like you to brake!
Heavens above! You nearly sent me to meet my maker!
Please! Drive slowly! I'm not ready for glory!
Ahh! Lord, I'm hit! Is this it? Is this the light?
Ow! Oh, sweet mercy... I forgive you. Eventually.
Oof! Why, Lord? Why always me?
Oh... oh dear. I think I saw an angel. Or a hubcap.
Yes, yes, of course, child. The Lord provides. And so do I.
Very well. Amen to that.
I'll do it. With the Lord's help. And a little of yours.
Certainly! It is more blessed to give than to receive.
Alright... alright. But I'll pray about it, too.
Oh, no, no, no. I couldn't. My conscience would never let me sleep.
I'm afraid not, child. The Lord says no, and so do my knees.
No! Heavens, no! What would the goats think?
Forgive me, but no.
Absolutely not. That's a sin. Probably. Several sins.
Heh heh! Oh, the Lord loves a cheerful heart!
Ha! Oh, bless you, that was wicked. Wickedly funny!
Hee hee! I shouldn't laugh. I'm laughing anyway!
Oh, ho ho! You'll have me in stitches, and I can't afford a doctor!
Oh! Well... I'll pray for you. Twice.
Such harsh words! The Lord hears everything, you know.
I forgive you, child. It hurts, but I forgive you.
Well, bless your heart, and your tongue, which clearly needs it.
I've been called worse, by better sinners.
Oh, please! Please, put it down! I'm just a humble servant!
Violence is never the answer! Well... rarely! Please!
Lord, protect me! Quickly, if you would!
Don't! Thou shalt not kill! It's in the Book! Page... one of them!
Bless you, child! Bless you a hundred times!
The Lord will remember your kindness. And so will I.
Thank you, thank you! You're an answered prayer!
Oh, bless your heart. Truly, this time.
Go with God, child. He drives a truck now, I hear.
May the road rise to meet you. Gently. Not too fast.
Farewell, pilgrim! Don't forget to pray! And to check your tyres!
Peace be with you. And stay away from the dark places!
Goodbye, goodbye! Oh, I do hope you come back alive!
The Lord bless you and keep you. Mostly keep you. Alive.
Oh, very well! Charity is a virtue. An expensive virtue.
Alright, child. It's for a good cause. Yours, apparently.
Fine, fine. The Lord loves a humble merchant. I'm being humbled.

How dare you! Have at you!
Take that, you ruffian!
Is that the best you have? How disappointing.
I've swatted flies with more menace!
Mind your manners, or I'll mind them for you!
Ah! You brute!
Oh! How dare you!
Ow! My word!
Aagh! Lord!
Oh! That was most uncivil!
I shall not stay for this indignity!
Lord preserve me! I'm leaving!
Run, run! Ladies first!
Enough! Enough, I yield! Please, have some decency!
I surrender! Take what you like, but spare my grandmother's silver!
Very well! You win! I hope you're proud of yourself.
Well, hey there, handsome! Or pretty. Hard to tell under all that dust.
Ooh, a customer! Come on over, friend, I got deals that'll make you cry.
Hi there! You look like somebody who needs something they don't know they need yet.
Howdy, stranger! Remember this face. You'll be telling stories about me.
Well, look at you! Walking around with all that scrap, just asking to spend it.
Hey, sugar! Don't be shy. My prices are low, and my morals are lower.
Welcome, welcome! Step into my office. It's a crate. It's a very nice crate.
Oh, hi! You're new. I love new. New doesn't know the prices yet.
Hey, you! Yeah, you! You look lucky. Wanna test that?
Well, butter my toast! A live one with pockets!
Buy low, sell high, and never, ever give refunds.
I sold a raider his own gang's flag. He saluted it. Beautiful.
Honesty is the best policy. That's why I don't have a policy.
Scrap, scrap, scrap... it's music, you know? Clinky little music.
One day, I'm gonna open a casino. With real dice. Well, weighted, but real.
The apocalypse is just a very aggressive market correction.
I've got a bridge to sell. The river's gone, but the bridge is great.
My daddy was a used-car salesman. I'm a used-everything saleswoman.
Lord, it's slow today. Somebody break something, so I can sell 'em a new one.
Every sucker has a silver lining. Usually in his pocket.
Water's free, they say. Not in my town, sugar.
Heh. That fella paid ten scrap for a 'lucky' rock. It was a potato.
I don't lie. I just tell the truth in a very creative order.
If you can't beat 'em, sell to 'em.
Rain! Umbrellas, three scrap! Raincoats, eight! Dry socks, name your price!
Snow! Oh, I love snow. Snow sells coats, boots, and a whole lot of whiskey.
Night time's when the real deals happen. The kind you don't tell your mama about.
Hot enough to melt the gold in your teeth. Which I'd buy, by the way.
Cold, cold, cold. Blankets are now a luxury item, folks.
Dust storm! Goggles for sale! Ain't nobody haggling with sand in their eyes!
Whoa, sugar! If you wanted my attention, you had it.
Hey! Hands where I can see 'em. Especially near my pockets.
Easy, cowboy! That's a bump fee, you know.
Oops! You bumped me, I bumped the price. Fair's fair.
Careful! I bruise like an overripe peach, and I bill like a lawyer.
Ooh, forward! I like that. Still gonna charge you.
Watch it, clumsy! This outfit's worth more than your car.
Whoa! Nice driving, hotshot! Wanna buy some brakes?
Hey! Slow down, I'm trying to run a business here!
Watch it! You almost hit your best supplier!
Ha! Missed me! Next time, try a bigger car!
Hey, speed racer! I've got a helmet, cheap!
Careful! You scratch me, you buy me!
Ow! You hit me! That's gonna cost you! Everything!
Agh! My hip! My money-making hip!
Oof! Hit and run? I'm gonna sell your plate to the highest bidder!
Ugh... Okay. I'm fine. My prices, however, just went up.
Deal! Pleasure doing business, sugar.
You betcha. I'm in.
Sure thing! What's my cut?
Alright, alright! You drive a charming bargain.
Why not? I love a gamble.
Ha! No. Nice try, though.
Oh, honey, no. Not even for money. Okay, maybe for a lot of money.
Nope. That's a losing bet.
Absolutely not. I know a scam when I see one. I invented half of 'em.
No dice, sugar.
Ha! Oh, you're good. You're really good.
Hahaha! Okay, that one's going in my sales pitch.
Ha! You're funnier than my accountant, and he's a goat.
Heh heh! I like you. Don't let it go to your head.
Wow. Rude. I'm adding that to your tab.
Oh, sugar. I've been called worse by better customers.
Careful, honey. My memory's long, and my prices are flexible.
Ha. That's cute. You're paying double now.
Keep talking. I'm writing it all down. In the price column.
Whoa! Easy, easy! Violence is bad for business!
You pull a weapon on me? In my own shop? Bold. Stupid, but bold.
Put that down, sugar, before I call in some favors.
Now, now. Let's talk this out. Talking's cheaper.
Well, thank you, sugar! You're a keeper.
Aw, thanks! I'd give you a discount, but I won't.
Much obliged, friend! Come back soon!
Thank you! I'll remember that. Probably.
Bye now! Tell your friends! Tell your enemies! Tell everybody!
See ya, sugar! Don't spend it all in one place. Spend it all here.
Adios! And remember, no refunds!
Take care! Watch your back, and your wallet!
Come back soon! I'm always open for business!
Later, friend! Stay lucky!
Ugh! You're robbing me! I love it! Deal!
Fine, fine! You out-hustled the hustler. I'm impressed.
Alright, sugar, you win. Don't tell anybody I blinked.
Ha! Cute. That's the price, and it's already a steal.
Nope. I don't haggle with amateurs.
Nice try, friend. I've been haggled by the best, and you ain't it.
Sold! And a bargain, if I do say so myself. And I do.
There you go! Pleasure doing business!
Enjoy! It's one of a kind. Well, one of several.
Sold! No backsies!
Ooh, I'll take that! Here's your scrap. Don't count it.
Hmm. Junk. Lovely junk. Deal!
I'll give you... this much. Final offer. Take it.
Sold to me! I'll flip that by sundown.
No scrap? Oh, sugar. You can't buy dreams with lint.
Short on funds, huh? I accept kidneys. Kidding! Mostly.
Come back when your pockets jingle, friend.
Oh, it's on, sugar!
You picked the wrong gal to mess with!
Alright! Let's make a deal: you lose!
Come on! I'll give you a discount on the beating!
Ha! Is that your best offer?
You fight like you haggle! Badly!
Take that! And that one's free!
Ow! Hey, that's not in the contract!
Agh! My face! My sales face!
Ouch! You'll pay for that! With interest!
Ahh! Dammit!
Ooh! Okay, that one hurt!
Nope! I'm out! Shop's closed!
Run! Protect the merchandise!
Forget it! I'm cashing out!
Okay! Okay! You win! Let's negotiate!
I surrender! Take the stock! Not the lucky rock! Okay, take the rock!
Mercy! I'll give you the family discount! Please!
Oh! Hi! Sorry, you scared me. Hi!
Um, hello! Are you friendly? You look friendly. Mostly.
Oh, hey there! Welcome! Sorry about the smell, the pigs got out.
Hi! Do you like chickens? Please say you like chickens.
Oh gosh, a visitor! Hang on, let me hide the... never mind. Hi!
Hello! You're not here to shoot anybody, right? Okay. Good. Great.
Hey! Oh, you look tired. Do you want some water? It's only a little brown.
Hi there! Sorry, I'm shaking. I always shake. It's not you. It's a little bit you.
Oh! Hello! Welcome to our farm. Well, it's more of a dirt patch with dreams.
Hi, hi! Um, watch out for the goat. She's nice. She's not nice.
Come on, Buttercup, eat your feed. Please? For me?
I named all the chickens. Then the coyotes came. I don't name them anymore.
Was that a noise? That was a noise. Oh no, oh no... it was the wind. Okay.
I think the corn's growing! Look, it's almost knee high. On a beetle.
Mama said the world would end in fire. I didn't think she meant so much fire.
Sorry, fence. I didn't mean to kick you. You just... were there.
If I sing to the tomatoes, they grow better. Or they're just being polite.
What if the raiders come back? What if they come back and they're nicer? That'd be worse, somehow.
Deep breaths, girl. Deep breaths. In through the nose, out through the... ooh, a butterfly!
I found a baby rabbit today. I'm keeping him. His name is Sir Hops-a-Lot.
Gosh, it's quiet. Too quiet. No, wait. Just the right amount of quiet. Right?
I used to be scared of the dark. Now I'm scared of everything. That's growth, I think.
One, two, three cows... where's number four? Oh, there you are. Don't do that.
Maybe tomorrow will be better. It's gotta be. Statistically.
Rain! The garden's gonna love this. Oh, but the mud. And the frogs. I love the frogs.
Snow! Oh, it's so pretty! And so cold! The chickens are gonna be so mad.
It's dark. It's really dark. I'm fine. Totally fine. Is that a wolf?
So hot... the cows are lying down, and so am I, in spirit.
Brr! My fingers are numb. I can't even milk the goat. She's relieved.
Dust storm! Get the animals in! Get the animals in! Oh, gosh, where's the goat?
Oh! Sorry! Sorry! Was that me? That was probably me.
Eek! Oh, it's you. You scared me half to death!
Oops! Sorry! I bruise easy. And I apologize easier.
Ah! Oh, gosh, you're solid!
Hey! Um, excuse me. Please. If that's okay.
Whoa! Careful, I'm holding eggs! Oh... I was holding eggs.
Oh no, did I get in your way? I'm always in the way.
Aah! Slow down! Please! Slow down!
Oh my gosh! You nearly squished me!
Eek! Watch out for the chickens!
Please drive slower! There's animals! And me!
Whoa! My heart! My heart just jumped out of my body!
Hey! That's scary! You're scary!
Ow! Ow, ow, ow! You hit me! I'm okay! I'm not okay!
Aah! Oh gosh, is this how it ends? In a ditch? With no chickens?
Ugh... I think I'm fine. I can wiggle my toes. Some of them.
Oww! Why? I was just standing here!
Okay! Yes! I can do that! I think!
Sure! Oh, I'd love to help!
Um, yes. Yes! Definitely yes.
Of course! What are friends for?
Alright! Wish me luck!
Oh, gosh, no. No, no, I couldn't. I'm sorry!
Um... no? Is that okay? It's no.
I don't think so. It sounds dangerous. Everything sounds dangerous.
No, sorry! Mama would never let me.
Nope! Sorry! No! Sorry!
Hee hee! Oh, that's so silly!
Ha! Oh gosh, I snorted! Sorry!
Hahaha! You're funny! Are all strangers this funny?
Tee hee! Oh, I needed that. Thank you!
Oh. That... that wasn't very nice.
Hey! You don't have to be mean about it!
Well, gosh. My goat is nicer than you, and she bites.
That's rude. I'm gonna go cry to the chickens now.
Um, excuse me! I have feelings! Small ones, but still!
Please don't! Please! I'll do anything!
Aah! Put it away! I'm just a farm girl!
Don't hurt me! Or the animals! Especially the animals!
Okay, okay! I'm scared! You win at being scary!
Oh, thank you! Thank you so much!
You're so kind! I could hug you! Can I hug you? No? Okay.
Gosh, thanks! That's the nicest thing anybody's done all week!
Thank you! Sir Hops-a-Lot thanks you too!
Bye! Be careful out there! Please!
See you! Don't get eaten!
Take care! Come visit the chickens sometime!
Bye-bye! Stay safe! Stay really, really safe!
Okay, bye! Drive slow! For the animals!
Goodbye! I'll pray for you! And worry about you! Mostly worry!
Oh, okay! You're right, that's fair. I think. Is it fair?
Alright, alright! I can't say no to a nice face.
Fine! Just this once! Don't tell my mama.
I'm sorry, I can't go lower! I have mouths to feed! Mostly goat mouths!
Um, no. That's the price. Sorry! Really sorry!
I wish I could, but the pigs need feed!
Here you go! I hope you like it!
Enjoy! I grew it myself! Well, the dirt helped.
There! Take good care of it, okay?
Sold! Oh, that's so exciting!
Oh, thank you! Here's your scrap!
I can use this! The goat will be so happy!
Sure! It's a deal! My first deal today!
Ooh, neat! Okay, here!
Oh, no, you don't have enough. I'm sorry! I'm really sorry!
Aw, you're short. Maybe next time?
I can't give it away, I'm sorry! The animals need to eat!
Stay away! I'm warning you! I think!
No! Leave us alone!
I'll protect them! I'll protect the chickens!
Go away! Shoo! Shoo!
I'm not scared of you! I'm very scared of you!
Take that! Sorry! Take that!
Leave my animals alone!
Ow! Ow! Ow!
Aah! That hurts!
Ahh! Please stop!
Oof! Oh, gosh!
Ow! Mama!
Run! Run! Run!
Aaah! I'm getting out of here!
Help! Somebody help!
Stop! Please! I give up! Just don't hurt the animals!
I surrender! I'm sorry! Whatever I did, I'm sorry!
Okay! Okay! You win! Please!

lines: Mornin', old-timer! Beautiful day, ain't it?
It's hot, it stinks, and you're talkin'. Ain't nothin' beautiful.
Well, shoot. Two outta three ain't bad.
You ever shut up about that truck of yours?
Never, old man. She was a queen.
She was a rust bucket with a horn.
Them's fightin' words, old man!
Hey, funny man! Heard any good ones lately?
Why'd the trucker bring a ladder to the bar? He heard the drinks were on the house.
Ha! Oh, that's terrible, buddy.
I'll be here all week. And every week. Help.
Psst, big fella. New face is watching us.
Well, then, let's give 'em a show, partner!
Ladies and gentlemen, it's the trucker and the comedian hour!
Ha! Folks, tip your bartender!
Preacher! You look pale, buddy.
I saw a shadow move, friend. A big one.
That was my shadow, preacher.
...Well, the Lord works in mysterious ways.
Will you say grace, brother?
Sure, preacher. Thank you, Lord, for this can of beans, and for not letting it explode.
Amen. That was... surprisingly moving.
I'm a man of many talents, partner.
Big man, you owe me ten scrap.
I don't owe nobody nothin'. I got a paper says so.
You wrote that paper yourself!
And it's a real good paper, trucker.
I'll buy your old truck horn. Two scrap.
Two scrap? That horn played 'La Cucaracha'!
Three scrap, and I don't gotta hear it.
You got no culture, buddy.
Mama! What's cookin'?
Gumbo, cher. Well, it's mostly water with an attitude.
Smells like heaven anyhow!
Flattery gets you seconds, baby.
You eat like a starving bear, cher.
Your cooking's too good, Mama. It's your fault.
Mm-hmm. Wash that bowl when you're done.
Yes, ma'am. Right away, ma'am.
Hey, grease monkey! My rig's makin' a funny noise.
It's always a funny noise with you, trucker.
This one's funnier! It goes clunk, clunk, bang.
That's your engine dying of embarrassment.
Who parked a bus on my workbench?
Now, that's a strong word, 'parked'. I'd say 'rested'.
Move it, or I'll rest my wrench on your head.
Yes, ma'am. Movin' it.
Afternoon, ma'am! Lovely hat.
Why, thank you, sir. Lovely... belt.
Heh. You noticed.
It is rather difficult not to.
Sir, must you yodel at dawn?
It's a trucker's call, ma'am! Wakes the soul!
It wakes the dead, sir. And they're filing complaints.
Darlin', that 'lucky rock' you sold me? Broke my tooth.
That's the luck, sugar! Could've been two teeth.
...I hadn't thought of it like that.
That's why I'm in sales.
Trucker, I got a proposition for you.
Does it involve me paying you?
It involves opportunity!
So, yes.
Hey there, little lady! How're the chickens?
Oh! Hi! Two laid eggs, and one laid down and refused to move.
Sounds like me on a Monday!
Hee hee! You're silly.
Is it true you drove through a tornado?
Twice, darlin'. Once forwards, once backwards.
Weren't you scared?
Terrified. But the radio was playing a good song.
Funny man, if you tell me one more joke, I'll feed you to the dogs.
Why did the old man threaten the comedian?
I'm warnin' you...
Too soon? Too soon.
Hey, old man, what's the difference between you and a cactus?
I dunno. What?
The cactus has a softer side.
Get outta my sight.
Preacher, you still prayin' for my soul?
Every night, old friend. It's a full-time job.
Well, quit. It's mine, and I'm keepin' it rotten.
Brother, have you considered forgiveness?
Sure. I forgive everybody. After I get even.
That's... not how it works.
Works for me.
How much for a jug of shine?
For you? Twelve scrap.
Twelve?! Yesterday it was eight!
Yesterday you didn't look this thirsty.
Old man, you're scarin' off my customers.
Good. Your customers are idiots.
Yeah, but they're my idiots.
Hmph. Fair.
Woman, this stew tastes like boot.
That's 'cause it is boot, old man. You didn't bring any meat.
...It's good boot, though.
Thank you, sugar.
You gonna say something nice, old man? Just once?
Nope.
Try, baby. For Mama.
...Your cornbread don't make me wanna die. There.
Girl, my wheelbarrow squeaks.
Oil it, old man.
I ain't got oil.
Then enjoy the music.
Old man, did you drink my brake fluid?
It was in a jug. Jugs are for drinkin'.
You're gonna glow tonight.
Saves on candles.
Morning, Your Highness.
Good morning, sir. You smell like a still.
And you smell like somebody who thinks she's better'n me.
I do not think it, sir. I know it.
Must you spit, sir?
Must you talk, lady?
Charming. Absolutely charming.
Yeah, I get that a lot. Not really.
Girl, that watch you sold me don't tell time.
It tells time, old man. It just doesn't tell it right.
What's the difference?!
About three scrap.
Old man, that stranger looks rich.
That stranger looks like trouble.
Rich trouble. My favorite kind.
Girl, keep that goat off my porch.
Sorry, sir! She likes you!
Nobody likes me.
Well, she does! She ate your hat because she loves you!
Mister, I baked you a pie!
...What kind?
Um. Mystery.
My favorite kind. Hand it over.
Preacher, how many preachers does it take to change a light bulb?
Oh, dear. How many?
None. We ain't got light bulbs.
Bless you, son. That was awful.
Son, do you think we'll see heaven?
Preacher, I think we're in the waiting room.
Then why does it smell like goat?
Nobody said it was a nice waiting room.
Big guy, how much for a laugh?
Five scrap.
What if I tell the joke?
Then you pay me to listen. Ten scrap.
Funny man, you're blockin' my stall.
I'm drawing a crowd, big guy! Free advertising!
The crowd's laughing at you, not buying stuff.
Same thing, in my business.
Mama, what's the secret ingredient?
Love, cher.
And?
And the mystery meat. But mostly love.
Baby, you gonna eat, or just make jokes about my cooking?
Why can't I do both?
'Cause Mama's got a spoon, baby.
Eating! Eating quietly!
Hey, what's the difference between you and a mechanic?
There is none, genius.
Right! That's the joke. I didn't think it through.
Clearly.
Did you put a whoopee cushion on my creeper?
Allegedly.
I nearly dropped a transmission on my face.
But you laughed first, right?
Ma'am, you look stunning today.
Thank you, dear. You look... awake.
It's a start!
Young man, your jokes are uncouth.
Uncouth? Ma'am, I don't even know what couth is.
That much is obvious, dear.
Hey, hustler, I got a joke for you.
Does it cost me anything?
Nope, it's free!
Then I don't want it.
Funny man, distract the stranger. I'll handle the sale.
Hey there! Wanna hear a joke about a hustler?
Hey!
It's a short one! She's standing right there!
Kid, why did the chicken cross the road?
Oh no, was it hurt? Is it okay?
It's... it's a joke, kid.
Oh! Oh, good. I was so worried.
Mister, can you make my goat laugh?
Goats are a tough crowd.
Please?
Fine. Hey, goat. Nice beard. ...Nothing. Told ya.
My son, charity is a virtue.
So is profit, preacher.
Where in the Good Book does it say that?
Page one hundred and scrap.
Preacher, you want a candle? Blessed. Only six scrap.
Blessed by who?
Me. I'm very spiritual.
Heaven help us.
Sister, will you sing at the service?
Of course, preacher! Which hymn?
Anything that drowns out the raiders.
Loud one, then.
Eat something, preacher, you're thin as a prayer.
The spirit feeds me, sister.
The spirit ain't got no cornbread. Eat.
Yes, sister.
Sister, would you bless my wheelbarrow?
I'll grease it. That's the same thing, to me.
Close enough. Amen.
Preacher, stop praying over my engines.
They need it, child.
They need spark plugs, not scripture.
Why not both?
My lady, you were radiant in church.
Why, thank you, Reverend. And you were... audible.
I do try to project.
The dead heard you, dear.
Reverend, the Lord surely has a plan for this wasteland.
I hope so, my lady. It'd be a shame if this was it.
Heaven forbid.
Exactly my prayer.
Child, you sold me a holy relic. It was a doorknob.
A holy doorknob, preacher. It opened the door to faith.
...That's clever. Still a doorknob.
No refunds on miracles.
Preacher, how about a raffle for the church?
What's the prize?
Salvation. Tickets are five scrap.
You can't raffle salvation, child!
Child, you look frightened.
I heard wolves last night, Reverend.
So did I. I prayed till sunrise.
Did it work?
Well, we're here. Praise be.
Reverend, do animals go to heaven?
I'm certain of it, child.
Even the mean goat?
...Especially her. She'll need it most.
Mama, I'll sell you six onions for twenty scrap.
Twenty? Baby, I'll give you ten and a bowl of gumbo.
Deal. Make it two bowls.
Mm-hmm. You drive a hungry bargain.
Big man, you're eating from the pot with your hands.
Saves on spoons.
Saves on manners, too. Spoon!
Okay, okay! Spoon!
Hey, grease girl, fix my cart for free?
Sure, big guy. Right after pigs fly.
My pigs can't fly.
Then I guess it ain't free.
You sold me a spark plug made of chalk.
It's vintage.
It's chalk, you crook.
Vintage chalk.
Ma'am! Fancy lady like you needs fancy stuff.
I have fancy stuff, dear. I don't need yours.
Mine's fancier.
Yours is stolen, dear.
Sir, your prices are criminal.
Thank you, ma'am.
It was not a compliment.
Sounded like one.
Hey, you're stealing my customers.
I'm not stealing, big guy. They're choosing better.
I'll lower my prices.
Then I'll lower mine. Race you to the bottom!
Big guy, that stranger's got deep pockets.
Dibs.
You can't call dibs on a customer!
Just did.
Hey, farm girl. How much for the goat?
She's not for sale!
Everything's got a price, kid.
Not Buttercup! Buttercup is family!
Mister, can you lend me a bag of feed?
Lend? Sure. Twelve percent interest.
What's interest?
It's why I'm rich and you're not.
Honey, you need to eat.
Can't, Mama. Got a transmission in pieces.
Transmission can wait. Your stomach can't.
...Fine. Just one bowl.
Mama, this stew tastes like motor oil.
It's the pan, baby. You washed it with gasoline.
...Oh. Yeah. That was me.
My lady! Come have some gumbo.
Is it... fresh, dear?
Fresh as a Sunday morning, sugar.
Then I suppose one small bowl wouldn't hurt.
Mama, your singing at dawn is lovely.
Why, thank you, cher!
It's also very early.
The Lord gets up early, baby. So does Mama.
Sugar, you sold my spoon back to me.
It was a very good spoon, Mama.
It was my spoon!
And now it's yours again! Everybody wins.
Mama, I'll sell your gumbo in the next town. Fifty-fifty.
Seventy-thirty, cher.
Sixty-forty?
Mama's gumbo, Mama's cut. Seventy-thirty.
Baby, you're shaking again.
I'm okay, Mama. I just heard a noise.
Come here, sugar. Eat something. Noise can't get you while you're eating.
Is that true?
It's true enough.
Mama, can you teach me to cook?
Of course, baby. Rule one: don't burn the roux.
What's a roux?
Lord, we got a lot of work to do.
Ma'am, your buggy's axle is bent.
Is that bad, dear?
It's bad for the axle, and worse for your hat.
Then fix it, please. The hat is irreplaceable.
Dear, you have grease on your face.
I have grease on my soul, ma'am.
I'll pray for it.
Pray for my back while you're at it.
You sold a fella a carburetor full of sand.
He asked for a 'desert special'.
That's not what that means!
It is now.
Hey, I need you to 'fix' a car so it breaks next week.
No.
Fifty scrap.
Still no. I got standards, you crook.
Kid, your tractor's leaking oil.
Oh no! Is it hurt?
It's a tractor, kid.
It has feelings! Probably!
Ma'am, can you fix my bucket?
It's got a hole in it.
Can you fix the hole?
...Yeah, kid. I can fix the hole.
Dear, is that my grandmother's brooch you're wearing?
This? Oh, I found it.
In my jewelry box?
It was very lost in there.
Ma'am, you'd look fabulous in this scarf.
That is my scarf, you thief.
And you look fabulous in it!
Give it back this instant.
Dear, sit up straight.
Oh! Sorry, ma'am!
A lady carries herself with dignity.
Even when the goat's chasing her?
...Especially then.
Ma'am, how do you stay so clean?
Discipline, dear. And standing upwind.
I'll try that!
Sweetie, I'll trade you this lucky horseshoe for two chickens.
Is it really lucky?
Look how shiny it is!
Um... okay, but you have to be nice to the chickens!
Hey, the horseshoe didn't work. The coyotes came anyway.
Did they eat you?
No...
See? Lucky!
Old man, you ever think about retiring?
Retire to what? A rocking chair and a shotgun?
Sounds nice, actually.
Keep the chair.
You smell like diesel, trucker.
Thank you!
Wasn't a compliment.
Everything's a compliment when it's about diesel.
Funny man, you're supposed to look scary.
I am looking scary. This is my scary face.
You look like you need a nap.
I DO need a nap.
Trucker, why do we always attack at dawn?
Element of surprise, buddy.
The surprise is that I'm awake.
Preacher, you blessed the ambush again?
Every ambush deserves a blessing.
Does the other side get one?
They get what's left.
Brother, have you confessed your sins?
Which ones, preacher? The list's long.
Start with the stolen trucks.
That'll take till Sunday.
